# A09-S94: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

And a really exciting offer under the Culture Week theme: New Horizons.

We don't have a registration system, so a link to an email or something else you can register with would be nice.

We have a Cultural Committee in the municipality, which is a group of volunteers from the various cultural associations who give out support.
You can read more about them here and their criteria for applying for support:
Tilskud til Kultur | Høje-Taastrup Kommune (htk.dk)<https://www.htk.dk/Foreningsservice/Foreningshaandbog/Tilskud-kultur>

The Cultural Committee primarily supports the cultural association life, but anyone can apply and there are also cultural institutions and private actors that sometimes receive support.

If you apply to Kulturelt Samråd via their form, I would recommend that you include some self-financing in the event you are seeking support for. The council emphasizes this when the applicant is not a volunteer association.
Kulturelt Samråd processes applications 4.Tuesday every month. The electronic form is filled out, and then you will receive a receipt.
